  const nowMinutes = hour * 60 + minute;

  return nowMinutes >= startMinutes && nowMinutes < (startMinutes + 60);

function getActiveSickTickerAlert() {
  const rawItem = String(Storage.get('rotastic_breaking_news_item', '') || '').trim();
  const meta = getActiveTickerMeta();
  const priority = getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta);

  if (!rawItem || meta.kind !== 'sick' || !priority.active) return null;

  if (!isWithinFirstHourOfSickDoctorsShift(meta, rawItem)) return null;

  return {
    message: formatSickBreakingMessage(rawItem, meta),
    meta: meta
  };
}

function clearSickInterruptTimer() {
  if (rotasticSickInterruptTimer) {
    clearTimeout(rotasticSickInterruptTimer);
    rotasticSickInterruptTimer = null;
  }
}

function scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt() {
  clearSickInterruptTimer();

  if (rotasticSickTakeoverActive || rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

  const alert = getActiveSickTickerAlert();
  if (!alert) return;

  // Let the current announcement breathe for five seconds, then interrupt it.
  rotasticSickInterruptTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    const currentAlert = getActiveSickTickerAlert();
    if (!currentAlert || rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

    rotasticSickTakeoverActive = true;

    if (headlineTickerTimer) {
      clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
      headlineTickerTimer = null;
    }

    renderFullWidthTickerTakeover('sick', currentAlert.message, 5000);
  }, 5000);
}

function renderFullWidthTickerTakeover(type, message, durationMs) {
  rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = Date.now();
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') {
    const hiddenTicker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
    if (hiddenTicker) hiddenTicker.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content) return;

  ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  setTickerFullWidthMode(true);
  content.innerHTML = '';

  const card = document.createElement('div');
  card.className = 'ticker-fullwidth-takeover ' +
    (type === 'sick'
      ? 'ticker-fullwidth-sick'
      : type === 'prayerMoment'
        ? 'ticker-fullwidth-prayer'
        : 'ticker-fullwidth-centre');

  if (type === 'sick') {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'ticker-breaking-chip';
    badge.textContent = 'BREAKING';

    const body = document.createElement('span');
    body.className = 'ticker-breaking-body';

    const sickLines = String(message || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean);
    if (sickLines.length > 1) {
      sickLines.forEach(function(line, index) {
        const lineEl = document.createElement('span');
        lineEl.className = 'ticker-breaking-line';
        lineEl.textContent = line;
        body.appendChild(lineEl);
      });
    } else {
      body.textContent = message;
    }

    card.appendChild(badge);
    card.appendChild(body);
  } else if (type === 'prayerMoment') {
    const badge = document.createElement('span');
    badge.className = 'ticker-prayer-moment-chip';

    const logo = document.createElement('img');
    logo.className = 'ticker-prayer-moment-logo';
    logo.src = 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=aladhan.com&sz=64';
    logo.alt = 'Prayer time source';
    logo.referrerPolicy = 'no-referrer';

    const label = document.createElement('span');
    label.textContent = 'PRAYER TIME';

    badge.appendChild(logo);
    badge.appendChild(label);

    const body = document.createElement('span');
    body.className = 'ticker-prayer-moment-body';
    body.textContent = message;

    card.appendChild(badge);
    card.appendChild(body);
  } else {
    card.textContent = message;
  }

  content.appendChild(card);

  if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
  headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    if (type === 'sick') {
      rotasticSickTakeoverActive = false;
    }

    // Keep the takeover visible until the next message renderer replaces it.
    renderNextTickerSlot();
  }, type === 'sick'
      ? 5000
      : type === 'prayerMoment'
        ? (durationMs || 6500)
        : (durationMs || getTickerDisplayDuration(message, 7000)));
}

function renderCentreIdentityCard() {
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

  // Preserve the original majestic slow zoom / letter-spacing animation.
  rotasticRunTickerTransition(function() {
    renderFullWidthTickerTakeover(
      'centre',
      'Abu Nakhla Health Centre',
      10000
    );
    scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
  }, false);
}

const rotasticTickerHistory = [];
let rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = -1;
let rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing = false;
let rotasticTickerTouchStartX = 0;
let rotasticTickerTouchStartY = 0;

function rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message) {
  if (rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) return;
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  if (!text) return;

  const last = rotasticTickerHistory[rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1];
  if (last && last.type === type && last.message === text) {
    rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
    return;
  }

  rotasticTickerHistory.push({
    type:type || 'general',
    message:text,
    medicalLink:type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : ''
  });

  if (rotasticTickerHistory.length > 30) rotasticTickerHistory.shift();
  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
}

function showRotasticTickerHistory(index) {
  if (!rotasticTickerHistory.length) return;

  const bounded = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1));
  const item = rotasticTickerHistory[bounded];
  if (!item) return;

  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = bounded;
  rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing = true;

  if (item.type =

---
ue || 0);

  return nowMinutes >= startMinutes && nowMinutes < (startMinutes + 60);
}

  };

let rotasticTickerTouchStartX = 0;
let rotasticTickerTouchStartY = 0;

function rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message) {
  if (rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) return;
  const text = String(message || '').trim();
  if (!text) return;

  const last = rotasticTickerHistory[rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1];
  if (last && last.type === type && last.message === text) {
    rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
    return;
  }

  rotasticTickerHistory.push({
    type:type || 'general',
    message:text,
    medicalLink:type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : ''
  });

  if (rotasticTickerHistory.length > 30) rotasticTickerHistory.shift();
  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1;
}

function showRotasticTickerHistory(index) {
  if (!rotasticTickerHistory.length) return;

  const bounded = Math.max(0, Math.min(index, rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1));
  const item = rotasticTickerHistory[bounded];
  if (!item) return;

  rotasticTickerHistoryCursor = bounded;
  rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing = true;

  if (item.type === 'medicalnews') {
    rotasticCurrentMedicalLink = item.medicalLink || '';
  }

  renderTickerCard(item.type, item.message, 15000, true);
  rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing = false;
}

function navigateRotasticTickerHistory(direction) {
  if (!rotasticTickerHistory.length) return;

  if (direction < 0) {
    if (rotasticTickerHistoryCursor <= 0) return;
    showRotasticTickerHistory(rotasticTickerHistoryCursor - 1);
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticTickerHistoryCursor < rotasticTickerHistory.length - 1) {
    showRotasticTickerHistory(rotasticTickerHistoryCursor + 1);
  } else {
    renderNextTickerSlot();
  }
}

function initializeTickerSwipeHistory() {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  if (!ticker || ticker.dataset.swipeHistoryBound === '1') return;
  ticker.dataset.swipeHistoryBound = '1';

  ticker.addEventListener('touchstart', function(event) {
    const touch = event.touches && event.touches[0];
    if (!touch) return;
    rotasticTickerTouchStartX = touch.clientX;
    rotasticTickerTouchStartY = touch.clientY;
  }, {passive:true});

  ticker.addEventListener('touchend', function(event) {
    const touch = event.changedTouches && event.changedTouches[0];
    if (!touch) return;

    const dx = touch.clientX - rotasticTickerTouchStartX;
    const dy = touch.clientY - rotasticTickerTouchStartY;

    // Horizontal swipe only; vertical scrolling/pull-to-refresh remains untouched.
    if (Math.abs(dx) < 48 || Math.abs(dx) <= Math.abs(dy) * 1.35) return;

    if (dx > 0) navigateRotasticTickerHistory(-1); // swipe right = previous
    else navigateRotasticTickerHistory(1);        // swipe left = next/resume
  }, {passive:true});
}


let rotasticTickerTransitionTimer = null;
let rotasticTickerTransitioning = false;

function rotasticRunTickerTransition(renderFn, immediate) {
  const row = document.getElementById('tickerInnerRow');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!row || !content || immediate || !String(content.textContent || '').trim()) {
    renderFn();
    if (row) {
      row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-out');
      row.classList.add('rotastic-ticker-fade-in');
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        requestAnimationFrame(function() { row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-in'); });
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticTickerTransitionTimer) clearTimeout(rotasticTickerTransitionTimer);
  rotasticTickerTransitioning = true;
  row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-in');
  row.classList.add('rotastic-ticker-fade-out');

  rotasticTickerTransitionTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    renderFn();
    row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-out');
    row.classList.add('rotastic-ticker-fade-in');
    requestAnimationFrame(function() {
      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-in');
        rotasticTickerTransitioning = false;
      });
    });
    rotasticTickerTransitionTimer = null;
  }, 320);
}

  if (!fromHistory) rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message);

    (type === 'rota' ? ' ticker-rota-change-card' : '') +

function renderTickerCardNow(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory) {
  rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = Date.now();
  message = String(message || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const knowledgeType = ['stat','medicalnews','worldnews','qnanews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews','nhsinfo'].includes(type);
  if (knowledgeType) message = fitNormalTickerCopy(message, 16, 112);
  else if (!['sick','centre','greeting','welcome','notification'].includes(type)) message = fitNormalTickerCopy(message, 18, 124) || message;
  if (!message) {
    message = nextDoctorEncouragement() || 'Wishing you a smooth and safe shift today.';
    type = 'encouragement';
  }
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') {
    const hiddenTicker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
    if (hiddenTicker) hiddenTicker.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content) return;
  ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
  setTickerFullWidthMode(false);
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  content.innerHTML = '';
  setTickerBadge(type, message);
  if (!fromHistory) rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message);
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  const leftAligned = ['safepractice','encouragement','stat','qatar','qnanews','medicalnews','worldnews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews','nhsinfo','prayer','admin','clinical','rota','general','notification'].includes(type);
  card.className = 'ticker-message-card ' + getTickerCopySizeClass(message) +
    (type === 'rota' ? ' ticker-rota-change-card' : '') +
    (leftAligned ? ' ticker-left-card' : '') +
    (type === 'prayer' ? ' ticker-prayer-card' : '');
  if (type === 'prayer') {
    const body = document.createElement('span');
    body.className = 'ticker-message-text';
    body.textContent = message;
    card.appendChild(body);
  } else if ((type === 'medicalnews' && rotasticCurrentMedicalLink) || (['qnanews','worldnews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews'].includes(type) && rotasticCurrentTickerLink)) {
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.className = 'ticker-medical-link';
    link.href = type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : rotasticCurrentTickerLink;
    link.target = '_blank';
    link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    link.textContent = message;
    link.title = 'Open source';
    card.appendChild(link);
  } else {
    card.textContent = message;
  }
  content.appendChild(card);
  if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
  const requestedDuration = Number(durationMs || 0);
  const comfortableDuration = getTickerDisplayDuration(message, 7800);
  const finalDuration = Math.max(requestedDuration, comfortableDuration);
  headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() { renderNextTickerSlot(); }, finalDuration);
  scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
}


function renderTickerCard(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory) {
  const immediate = type === 'sick' || type === 'greeting' || type === 'welcome';
  rotasticRunTickerTransition(function() {
    renderTickerCardNow(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory);
  }, immediate);
}

function choosePrayerMessage(prayerTimes) {
  const list = getRelevantPrayerMessages(prayerTimes);
  if (!list.length) return '';
  const message = list[prayerTickerIndex % list.length];
  prayerTickerIndex = (prayerTickerIndex + 1) % list.length;
  return message;
}

    return msg !== rotasticLastGreetingVibe;
  });

  if (!options.length) options = ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.slice();

  const message = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
  rotasticLastGreetingVibe = message;
  return messag

      requestAnimationFrame(function() {
        row.classList.remove('rotastic-ticker-fade-in');
        rotasticTickerTransitioning = false;
      });
    });
    rotasticTickerTransitionTimer = null;
  }, 320);
}

function renderTickerCardNow(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory) {
  rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = Date.now();
  message = String(message || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const knowledgeType = ['stat','medicalnews','worldnews','qnanews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews','nhsinfo'].includes(type);
  if (knowledgeType) message = fitNormalTickerCopy(message, 16, 112);
  else if (!['sick','centre','greeting','welcome','notification'].includes(type)) message = fitNormalTickerCopy(message, 18, 124) || message;
  if (!message) {
    message = nextDoctorEncouragement() || 'Wishing you a smooth and safe shift today.';
    type = 'encouragement';
  }
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') {
    const hiddenTicker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
    if (hiddenTicker) hiddenTicker.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content) return;
  ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
  setTickerFullWidthMode(false);
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  content.innerHTML = '';
  setTickerBadge(type, message);
  if (!fromHistory) rememberRotasticTickerItem(type, message);
  const card = document.createElement('div');
  const leftAligned = ['safepractice','encouragement','stat','qatar','qnanews','medicalnews','worldnews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews','nhsinfo','prayer','admin','clinical','rota','general','notification'].includes(type);
  card.className = 'ticker-message-card ' + getTickerCopySizeClass(message) +
    (type === 'rota' ? ' ticker-rota-change-card' : '') +
    (leftAligned ? ' ticker-left-card' : '') +
    (type === 'prayer' ? ' ticker-prayer-card' : '');
  if (type === 'prayer') {
    const body = document.createElement('span');
    body.className = 'ticker-message-text';
    body.textContent = message;
    card.appendChild(body);
  } else if ((type === 'medicalnews' && rotasticCurrentMedicalLink) || (['qnanews','worldnews','alarabiyanews','reutersnews'].includes(type) && rotasticCurrentTickerLink)) {
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.className = 'ticker-medical-link';
    link.href = type === 'medicalnews' ? rotasticCurrentMedicalLink : rotasticCurrentTickerLink;
    link.target = '_blank';
    link.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    link.textContent = message;
    link.title = 'Open source';
    card.appendChild(link);
  } else {
    card.textContent = message;
  }
  content.appendChild(card);
  if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
  const requestedDuration = Number(durationMs || 0);
  const comfortableDuration = getTickerDisplayDuration(message, 7800);
  const finalDuration = Math.max(requestedDuration, comfortableDuration);
  headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() { renderNextTickerSlot(); }, finalDuration);
  scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
}


function renderTickerCard(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory) {
  const immediate = type === 'sick' || type === 'greeting' || type === 'welcome';
  rotasticRunTickerTransition(function() {
    renderTickerCardNow(type, message, durationMs, fromHistory);
  }, immediate);
}

function choosePrayerMessage(prayerTimes) {
  const list = getRelevantPrayerMessages(prayerTimes);
  if (!list.length) return '';
  const message = list[prayerTickerIndex % list.length];
  prayerTickerIndex = (prayerTickerIndex + 1) % list.length;
  return message;
}



const ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES = [
  'Hope you have a smooth shift today.',
  'Wishing you a calm and safe shift.',
  'Hope today feels steady and manageable.',
  'Have a good shift and remember to hydrate.',
  'Wishing you a positive and uncomplicated day.',
  'Take it one patient at a time today.',
  'Hope the clinic stays calm and kind to you.',
  'Remember to pause, hydrate and reset when you can.',
  'Wishing you clear decisions and an easy workflow.',
  'Hope you get a few quiet moments between patients.',
  'Keep it calm, careful and compassionate today.',
  'Wishing you a safe shift and an easy handover.',
  'Look after yourself while you look after everyone else.',
  'Hope today brings more smiles than surprises.',
  'May your shift be smooth and your coffee stay warm.',
  'Wishing you a steady pace and a good team around you.',
  'Stay hydrated and give yourself a moment to breathe.',
  'Hope the day runs gently from start to finish.',
  'Wishing you good energy for the whole shift.',
  'Have a safe shift and be kind to yourself too.'
];

let rotasticLastGreetingVibe = '';

function nextGreetingVibe() {
  if (!ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.length) return '';

  let options = ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.filter(function(msg) {
    return msg !== rotasticLastGreetingVibe;
  });

  if (!options.length) options = ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.slice();

  const message = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
  rotasticLastGreetingVibe = message;
  return message;
}

  const doctor = String(activeUserDocName || '').replace(/^Dr\.?\s*/i, '').trim();
  cons

ou can.',
  'Wishing you clear decisions and an easy workflow.',
  'Hope you get a few quiet moments between patients.',
  'Keep it calm, careful and compassionate today.',

  'Look after yourself while you look after everyone else.',
  'Hope today brings more smiles than surprises.',
  'May your shift be smooth and your coffee stay warm.',

let rotasticLastGreetingVibe = '';

function nextGreetingVibe() {
  if (!ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.length) return '';

  let options = ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.filter(function(msg) {
    return msg !== rotasticLastGreetingVibe;
  });

  if (!options.length) options = ROTASTIC_GREETING_VIBES.slice();

  const message = options[Math.floor(Math.random() * options.length)];
  rotasticLastGreetingVibe = message;

function buildRecurringDoctorGreeting() {
  const doctor = String(activeUserDocName || '').replace(/^Dr\.?\s*/i, '').trim();
  const first = doctor.split(/\s+/)[0] || 'Doctor';

  let hour = new Date().getHours();
  try {
    hour = parseInt(
      new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
        timeZone:'Asia/Qatar',
        hour:'2-digit',
        hour12:false
      }).format(new Date()),
      10
    );
  } catch (e) {}

  const greeting =
    hour < 12 ? 'Good morning' :
    hour < 17 ? 'Good afternoon' :
    'Good evening';

  const wish = nextGreetingVibe();
  return greeting + ', Dr ' + first + '.\n' + wish;
}

async function renderNextTickerSlot() {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  if (!ticker) return;

  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') {
    ticker.classList.add('hidden');
    return;
  }

  if (!profileSetupIsComplete()) {
    renderPersistentFirstSetupTicker();
    return;
  }

  const launchNotification = rotasticTakeLaunchTickerNotification();
  if (launchNotification) {
    rotasticMarkNotificationShownOnce(launchNotification);
    const launchText = '🔔 ' + String(launchNotification.message || 'You have a new ROTASTIC notification.');
    renderTickerCard('notification', launchText, 15000);
    return;
  }

  // After all launch notifications have appeared once, preserve the standard
  // greeting → centre identity → normal announcement sequence.
  if (!rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun && !rotasticOpeningTickerActive) {
    startOpeningTickerSequence();
    return;
  }

  const tickerFetches = await Promise.allSettled([
    fetchAbuNakhlaPrayerTimes(),
    refreshLiveClinicalUpdates(),
    refreshQatarAchievementNews(),
    refreshLocalTrafficUpdate(),
    refreshExternalHeadlineFeeds()
  ]);
  const prayerTimes = tickerFetches[0] && tickerFetches[0].status === 'fulfilled'
    ? tickerFetches[0].value
    : null;

  tickerSlotCounter += 1;

  const rawItem = String(Storage.get('rotastic_breaking_news_item', '') || '').trim();
  const meta = getActiveTickerMeta();

  // Live rota changes are highlighted in the same top ticker with a distinct style.
  const rotaAlert = Storage.getJSON('rotastic_rota_change_alert', null);
  if (rotaAlert && rotaAlert.message && Number(rotaAlert.expiresAt || 0) > Date.now()) {
    if (tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
      renderTickerCard('rota', rotaAlert.message, 8500);
      return;
    }
  }

  // In the final 30 minutes, insert a concise, positive personal message plus
  // tomorrow's rota note without stopping the existing ticker/news rotation.
  const lastThirtyMessage = getLastThirtyMinuteTickerMessage();
  if (lastThirtyMessage && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('general', lastThirtyMessage, getTickerDisplayDuration(lastThirtyMessage, 7200));
    return;
  }
  const sickPriority = getSickAlertPriorityWindow(meta);
  const isSickPriorityActive = rawItem && meta.kind === 'sick' && sickPriority.active;
  const isAdminNotice = rawItem && meta.kind === 'admin';

  const prayerMoment = getPrayerMomentAlert(prayerTimes);
  if (prayerMoment && tickerSlotCounter % 2 === 1 && !isSickPriorityActive) {
    renderFullWidthTickerTakeover(
      'prayerMoment',
      prayerMoment.message,
      6500
    );
    return;
  }

  // Normal stream: fixed category order, shuffled content inside each category:
  // Every cycle includes motivational lines and practical clinical advice.
  // 0 Greeting (brief)
  // 1 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 2 Relevant prayer
  // 3 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 4 Positive safe-practice advice
  // 5 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 6 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // 7 Greeting (brief, different positive line)
  // 8 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 9 Current QNA / Al Jazeera headline
  // 10 Qatar / PHCC medical statistic
  // 11 Positive doctor encouragement
  // 12 Qatar / Arab-region medical news
  // 13 NHS global/relevant health item
  // 14 Abu Nakhla identity animation
  // then repeat.
  // This makes public-health statistics and medical news much more visible.

  if (isAdminNotice && tickerSlotCounter % 3 === 1) {
    renderTickerCard('admin', conciseTickerText(rawItem, 105), 6500);
    return;
  }

  const cycleStep = rotasticContentCycleIndex % 15;
  rotasticContentCycleIndex = (rotasticContentCycleIndex + 1) % 15;

  if (cycleStep === 0 || cycleStep === 7) {
    renderTickerCard('encouragement', nextDoctorEncouragement(), 5800);
    return;
  }

  if (cycleStep === 1 || cycleStep === 5 || cycleStep === 10) {
    rotasticMedicalStatCycleCount += 1;

    // Keep the stream focused on public-health numbers. Qatar fun facts remain
    // occasional rather than replacing a quarter of the medical-stat slots.
    const stat = chooseWeightedMedicalStat();
    if (stat) {
      renderTickerCard('stat', stat, 6000);
      return;
    }

    renderTickerCard('encouragement',

---
try for you today. Enjoy the breathing space ☕🙂',
      room:'',
      roomNumbers:[],
      clinics:[],
      emergency:[],
      codeBlue:[],
      shiftLead:'',
      shiftLabel:'',
      holiday:context.holiday
    };
  }

  const shift = today[timing.period] || {};
  const emergency = collectEmergencyDuties(shift, profile);
  const clinics = collectSpecialClinicDuties(shift, profile);
  const rooms = getRoomAssignmentsForDoctor(shift, profile);
  const cb = timing.period === 'am' ? today.cbAM : today.cbPM;
  const codeBlue = collectCodeBlueDuties(cb, profile);
  const shiftLead = cleanDoctorName(
    today[timing.period === 'am' ? 'shiftLeadAM' : 'shiftLeadPM'] || ''
  );

  let assignment = '';

  if (clinics.length) {
    assignment = 'You are on ' + clinics.join(' and ') + ' today.';
  } else if (emergency.length) {
    assignment = 'You are covering ' + emergency.join(' and ') + ' today.';
  } else {
    assignment = 'You are on the ' + timing.label + ' shift today.';
  }

  let room = '';
  if (rooms.length === 1) {
    room = 'You are in Room ' + rooms[0] + ' today.';
  } else if (rooms.length > 1) {
    room = 'You are in Rooms ' + rooms.join(' and ') + ' today.';
  }

  return {
    hasProfile:true,
    greeting:context.standardGreeting,
    detail:assignment + ' ' + getRotasticShiftWish(),
    room:room,
    roomNumbers:rooms,
    clinics:clinics,
    emergency:emergency,
    codeBlue:codeBlue,
    shiftLead:shiftLead,
    shiftLabel:timing.label || '',
    holiday:context.holiday
  };
}

function buildOpeningBriefingMessage() {
  const data = getOpeningBriefingData();
  return [data.greeting, data.detail, data.room].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}


function renderPersonalOpeningRotaBriefing(data, totalDurationMs) {
  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content || !data) return false;

  const hasDuty =
    (data.roomNumbers && data.roomNumbers.length) ||
    (data.clinics && data.clinics.length) ||
    (data.emergency && data.emergency.length) ||
    (data.codeBlue && data.codeBlue.length) ||
    data.shiftLead ||
    data.shiftLabel;

  if (!data.hasProfile || !hasDuty) return false;

  setTickerFullWidthMode(false);
  ticker.classList.add('ticker-greeting-mode', 'ticker-personal-rota-briefing');
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  content.innerHTML = '';
  setTickerBadge('greeting', data.greeting || 'Your shift');

  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.className = 'opening-rota-briefing';

  const top = document.createElement('div');
  top.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-top';

  const copy = document.createElement('div');
  copy.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-copy';

  const greeting = document.createElement('div');
  greeting.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-greeting';
  greeting.textContent = data.greeting || 'Good day, Doctor';

  const shift = document.createElement('div');
  shift.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-shift';
  shift.textContent = data.shiftLabel
    ? 'Your ' + data.shiftLabel + ' briefing'
    : 'Your rota briefing';

  copy.appendChild(greeting);
  copy.appendChild(shift);

  const roomHero = document.createElement('div');
  roomHero.className = 'opening-rota-room-hero';

  const roomLabel = document.createElement('div');
  roomLabel.className = 'opening-rota-room-label';

  const roomValue = document.createElement('div');
  roomValue.className = 'opening-rota-room-value';

  if (data.roomNumbers && data.roomNumbers.length) {
    roomLabel.textContent = data.roomNumbers.length === 1 ? 'ROOM' : 'ROOMS';
    roomValue.textContent = data.roomNumbers.join(' / ');
  } else if (data.clinics && data.clinics.length) {
    roomLabel.textContent = 'CLINIC';
    roomValue.className += ' opening-rota-room-value-clinic';
    roomValue.textContent = cleanClinicLabelForSentence(data.clinics[0]);
  } else {
    roomLabel.textContent = 'TODAY';
    roomValue.textContent = 'DUTY';
  }

  roomHero.appendChild(roomLabel);
  roomHero.appendChild(roomValue);

  top.appendChild(copy);
  top.appendChild(roomHero);
  wrap.appendChild(top);

  const details = document.createElement('div');
  details.className = 'opening-rota-briefing-details';

  function addBriefingItem(iconClass, label, value, accentClass) {
    if (!value) return;
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'opening-rota-detail-item ' + (accentClass || '');

    const icon = document.createElement('i');
    icon.className = iconClass;

    const body = document.createElement('div');
    const labelEl = document.createElement('div');
    labelEl.className = 'opening-rota-detail-label';
    labelEl.textContent = label;

    const valueEl = document.createElement('div');
    valueEl.className = 'opening-rota-detail-value';
    valueEl.textContent = value;

    body.appendChild(labelEl);
    body.appendChild(valueEl);
    item.appendChild(icon);
    item.appendChild(body);
    details.appendChild(item);
  }

  addBriefingItem(
    'fa-solid fa-user-shield',
    'Shift lead',
    data.shiftLead || 'Not assigned',
    'detail-lead'
  );

  if (data.codeBlue && data.codeBlue.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-heart-pulse',
      'Code Blue',
      data.codeBlue.join(' · ').replace(/[💙⚡]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-codeblue'
    );
  }

  if (data.emergency && data.emergency.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-truck-medical',
      'Emergency responsibility',
      data.emergency.join(' · ').replace(/[🚑🧸]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-emergency'
    );
  }

  if (data.clinics && data.clinics.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-stethoscope',
      'Clinic',
      data.clinics.join(' · ').replace(/[👶🤰🩺😷👂🚭🌸]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-clinic'
    );
  }

  wrap.appendChild(details);
  content.appendChild(wrap);

  rememberRotasticTickerItem(
    'greeting',
   

---
data.clinics && data.clinics.length) {
    addBriefingItem(
      'fa-solid fa-stethoscope',
      'Clinic',
      data.clinics.join(' · ').replace(/[👶🤰🩺😷👂🚭🌸]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
      'detail-clinic'
    );
  }

  wrap.appendChild(details);
  content.appendChild(wrap);

  rememberRotasticTickerItem(
    'greeting',
    [
      data.greeting,
      data.room,
      data.codeBlue?.join(' '),
      data.emergency?.join(' '),
      data.shiftLead ? 'Shift lead: ' + data.shiftLead : ''
    ].filter(Boolean).join(' — ')
  );

  const duration = Math.max(1700, Number(totalDurationMs || 2200));
  if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
  headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode', 'ticker-personal-rota-briefing');
    renderNextTickerSlot();
  }, duration);

  scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
  return true;
}

function renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(data, totalDurationMs, recurring, persistent) {
  rotasticTickerLastRenderAt = Date.now();
  // On true app opening, show a compact personal rota briefing with a very
  // prominent room/clinic assignment plus Code Blue, emergency and shift lead.
  // Recurring greeting slots remain the lighter good-vibes treatment.
  // Opening sequence uses one typewriter greeting only. Personal duty details remain in Personal View.


  if (recurring && data) {
    const freshVibe = nextGreetingVibe();
    if ('positiveMessage' in data) data.positiveMessage = freshVibe;
    if ('wish' in data) data.wish = freshVibe;
    if ('message' in data && !('positiveMessage' in data) && !('wish' in data)) {
      data.message = freshVibe;
    }
    if ('detail' in data && freshVibe) {
      data.detail = freshVibe;
    }
  }

  const ticker = document.getElementById('swapsNewsTicker');
  const content = document.getElementById('tickerContent');
  if (!ticker || !content) return;

  setTickerFullWidthMode(false);
  ticker.classList.add('ticker-greeting-mode');
  ticker.classList.remove('hidden');
  content.innerHTML = '';
  setTickerBadge('greeting', data.greeting || 'Greeting');

  if (!rotasticTickerHistoryBrowsing) {
    rememberRotasticTickerItem(
      'greeting',
      [data.greeting, data.detail].filter(Boolean).join(' — ')
    );
  }

  const hero = document.createElement('div');
  hero.className = 'ticker-opening-hero';

  const copy = document.createElement('div');
  copy.className = 'ticker-opening-copy';

  const greeting = document.createElement('div');
  greeting.className = 'ticker-opening-greeting';
  greeting.textContent = data.greeting || 'Good day, Doctor';

  const detail = document.createElement('div');
  detail.className = 'ticker-opening-detail';

  const cursor = document.createElement('span');
  cursor.className = 'ticker-typewriter-cursor';

  copy.appendChild(greeting);
  copy.appendChild(detail);
  hero.appendChild(copy);
  content.appendChild(hero);

  // Keep the animated line concise enough to fit cleanly in two lines.
  const detailText = String(data.detail || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

  let index = 0;
  const chars = Array.from(detailText);
  const total = Math.max(4200, Number(totalDurationMs || 5000));
  const typingBudget = Math.min(1150, Math.max(650, chars.length * 14));
  const delay = chars.length
    ? Math.max(14, Math.min(38, typingBudget / chars.length))
    : 20;

  const finishGreeting = function() {
    if (persistent) return;

    const elapsedTyping = chars.length * delay;
    const hold = Math.max(900, total - elapsedTyping);

    if (headlineTickerTimer) clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(function() {
      ticker.classList.remove('ticker-greeting-mode');
      renderNextTickerSlot();
    }, hold);
  };

  const typeNext = function() {
    if (index >= chars.length) {
      if (cursor.parentNode) cursor.remove();
      finishGreeting();
      return;
    }

    detail.textContent += chars[index++];
    detail.appendChild(cursor);
    headlineTickerTimer = setTimeout(typeNext, delay);
  };

  if (chars.length) {
    typeNext();
  } else {
    finishGreeting();
  }

  if (!persistent) {
    scheduleSickTakeoverInterrupt();
  }
}
let rotasticOpeningTickerActive = false;
let rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer = null;



function isSchedulablePhysician(name) {
  return !isDrNabina(name);
}

function isPrivilegedAdminDoctor(name) {
  return [
    'Dr Zaid SE.',
    'Dr Moursi',
    'Dr. Moursi',
    'Dr Mohamed M.',
    'Dr Nabina',
    'Dr. Nabina'
  ].includes(String(name || '').trim());
}

function isDrNabina(name) {
  return /Dr\.?\s*Nabina/i.test(String(name || '').trim());
}

function profileSetupIsComplete() {
  return Storage.get('rotastic_setup_completed', 'false') === 'true' && !!activeUserDocName;
}

function renderPersistentFirstSetupTicker() {
  if (headlineTickerTimer) {
    clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = null;
  }

  const data = getOpeningBriefingData();
  renderOpeningTypewriterBriefing(data, 0, false, true);
}

async function startOpeningTickerSequence() {
  if (rotasticActiveTab !== 'schedule') return;

  if (rotasticLaunchNotificationQueue.length) {
    Promise.resolve(renderNextTickerSlot()).catch(function(e) {
      console.warn('ROTASTIC launch notification ticker:', e);
    });
    return;
  }

  if (!profileSetupIsComplete()) {
    rotasticOpeningTickerActive = true;
    renderPersistentFirstSetupTicker();
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun) {
    if (!headlineTickerTimer && !rotasticOpeningTickerActive) {
      Promise.resolve(renderNextTickerSlot()).catch(function(e) {
        console.warn('ROTASTIC ticker resume:', e);
      });
    }
    return;
  }

  if (rotasticOpeningTickerActive) return;

  rotasticOpeningSequenceHasRun = true;
  rotasticOpeningTickerActive = true;

  if (headlineTickerTimer) {
    clearTimeout(headlineTickerTimer);
    headlineTickerTimer = null;
  }
  if (rotasticOpeningHardHandoffTimer) {
    clearTim
